test_shared_ptr_cpp_arg: test that a Python subclass passed as a shared_ptr C++ argument keeps its Python reference alive after deletion
test_shared_ptr_cpp_prop: test that setting a Python subclass as a C++ object property preserves the Python instance across garbage collection
test_shared_ptr_arg_identity: test that a pure C++ SpBase object passed as a shared_ptr argument loses its Python reference after deletion
test_shared_ptr_alias_nonpython: test that C++-created objects gain a Python instance only when retrieved and lose it after garbage collection
test_shared_ptr_goaway: test that SpGoAway objects are garbage collected on the Python side while remaining alive on the C++ side
